panels.title: Work queue depth — payments-provider.work
panels.description: Messages ready plus in flight. Only climbs when the third party fails slowly enough to pin every consumer's in-flight slots (e.g. flaky-upstream's hang mode) — a fast failure dead-letters before a backlog can form. See the dead-letter panel for that case.

panels.title: Dead-letter queue depth — payments-provider.work.dead
panels.description: Messages that exhausted the broker's own delivery limit (x-delivery-limit, 3 attempts). Nothing here recovers them — that is a later article's problem.

panels.title: Calls to the third party, by outcome
panels.description: egress_consumer_calls_total, from the fleet's own /metrics. No circuit state to break this down by — only whether each daemon's own last call worked.

panels.title: Active consumers on the work queue
panels.description: The broker's own count — should track --scale rmq-consumer=N. A gap between this and the replica count means a daemon has stopped consuming.
